sloka: तानि प्रयत्न अभिसमाहितानि ।मयेन साक्षाद् इव निर्मितानि ।मही तले सर्व गुण उत्तराणि ।ददर्श लन्का अधिपतेर् ग्Rहाणि ॥५-७-४॥
transliteration: tāni prayatna abhisamāhitāni ।mayena sākṣād iva nirmitāni ।mahī tale sarva guṇa uttarāṇi ।dadarśa lankā adhipater gRhāṇi ॥5-7-4॥

translations.english: The mansions of the lord of Lanka built with great care and effort on earth were by all means excellent and appeared as though built personally by Maya (the divine architect wellknown for magical skills).
